replaced the zh aliases on the seven is_retained movement lines. All seven carried the identical list 保留溢利 / 未分配利润 / 留存收益 / 累计亏损 — four spellings of the retained-earnings BALANCE, which is bs_equity__retained_profits' own label and the is_retained SECTION's name, not any movement inside it. Measured before this: 未分配利润 on a profit_and_loss page matched is_retained__cash_div_pref_shares EXACT at 1.0 (first of seven tied at priority 10) while the captions those lines are actually printed under — 对所有者（或股东）的分配, 提取法定盈余公积 — matched nothing. Each line now carries the CAS 所有者权益变动表 wording for its own movement plus the HK equivalent; the four balance spellings stay on bs_equity__retained_profits alone, which is the refuse-and-redirect the English side already used. The residual bucket is_retained__other_adj_to_retained_profits gets none: residual_framework.prohibitions says it is never populated by an alias match.

moved the English alias 'Undistributed profits' off the six is_retained movement lines and onto bs_equity__retained_profits — the same borrowed-balance defect the zh change above fixed. Measured before this, it was matchable ONLY where it is wrong: 'Undistributed profits' on a profit_and_loss page matched is_retained__cash_div_pref_shares EXACT (first of six tied at priority 10) while on a balance_sheet page it matched NOTHING, because the balance line did not own its own caption. So this denial adds as well as removes: the concept whose Chinese already includes 未分配利润, the exact translation, now answers to the English too and the two scripts agree. AND THE RULEBOOK CARRIED ALL OF IT: output_csv_hk_ontology.json declared 'Undistributed profits' plus the four Chinese spellings on the same seven concepts (40 aliases), and services.ontology_projection.SAME copies aliases/aliases_i18n verbatim — so the zh change above would have been undone by the next scripts/build_line_items.py run. opened the statement gate on the seven is_retained movement lines: each now declares statements: [equity_changes, profit_and_loss] where it declared only the section's profit_and_loss. Every one of them is a movement in retained earnings — dividends declared, transfers to statutory reserves, prior-period restatements — which a filing prints in the statement of changes in equity (所有者权益变动表) and not on the income statement, so the gate refused them on the one statement whose captions they are and admitted them on one whose captions they are not. TWO THINGS TRAVEL WITH IT, both recorded in the commit: services.face_context now folds the equity statement's two spellings (StatementType says equity_changes, the page classifier says changes_in_equity) so the block and the citations for these lines are not silently empty; and stages.map_ontology refuses to claim a row whose every figure is a MATRIX COLUMN, because no consumer publishes such a value — see that refusal for what is still missing.

normalisation.wrapped_caption_rule: On a bilingual HKEX statement a caption printed across two physical lines ('TOTAL COMPREHENSIVE' / '年內全面虧損總額' / 'LOSS FOR THE YEAR') must be reassembled from the value row upward before matching. Match the reassembled string first; only if that fails may the bare fragment be used, and then only against concepts whose include criteria explicitly admit the fragment.

binding.note: Precedence is section-first. A concept can only claim a row printed inside one of its section_scope values.
order: 1. Resolve the statement (balance_sheet / profit_and_loss / cash_flow) from the page or table caption.

2. Resolve the printed section from the nearest preceding section header. If no header is resolvable, the row is unbound: route to review, never guess a section. (A row WITH a resolved section that no concept claims is not unbound — it is swept into that section's residual; see unbound_row_policy.)
3. Restrict the candidate concept set to concepts whose section_scope contains the resolved section.
4. Rule tier: exact normalised alias, then regex_hints, in descending match_priority. Any exclude_hints hit is a hard veto, not a score penalty.
5. Semantic tier over the restricted set only, using definition + include + exclude. Never over the full ontology.
6. Tie between concepts listed in each other's confusable_with: resolve with section_disambiguation; if still tied, emit both as candidates and route to review. Never pick by declaration order.
7. Residual sweep (see residual_framework) runs last, over rows no dedicated concept claimed.
8. Reconcile the section against its reported subtotal.
binding.unbound_row_policy: Route an unclaimed face value only to the residual for its resolved printed section. Never borrow a neighbouring concept or cross a section. After all mapping and gap-closing opportunities, the engine-level face_mapping_contract gives any remaining face value a unique engine_unclassified_face key outside the ontology/template namespaces. This keeps the row stored and reviewable without feeding it into an unrelated calculation. Verified non-additive aggregates replaced by mapped components remain evidence-only.
binding.match_priority: Integer 0-99, higher evaluated first. Long specific captions rank above short generic ones so 'Total assets less current liabilities' cannot be pre-empted by 'Total current liabilities' on token overlap. Residuals are 0 and unreachable by matching.

prompt: Map each line item basis their definition, additional information provided and exclusion criteria. Rely on financial meaning and not just words - these are HKEX / PRC filings.

sign_convention.stored_value: The reported value after paren-to-negative conversion.
sign_convention.expenses_and_outflows: Stored NEGATIVE. This is required by the template: pl_gross_profit = sum(revenue, cost_of_goods_sold) and pl_profit_before_exceptional_items_and_tax = sum(total_income, total_operating_cost, total_non_operating_expense) only hold if expense concepts carry a negative sign.
sign_convention.unsigned_source: Where a filing prints expenses as unsigned positives in a by-nature list, negate on load and set sign_normalised: true on the fact so the transformation is auditable.
sign_convention.either: Subtotals, working-capital movements, fair-value changes, share of results, OCI and net cash flows are sign-indeterminate. Retain the reported sign; never coerce.
sign_convention.validation: A concept whose sign_convention is positive_expected or negative_expected but whose loaded value carries the opposite sign is a review trigger, not an auto-correction.

global_rules.face_only_default: Concepts default to face_only: true. Notes are evidence for a face amount, never an independent source of one, unless note_use is decomposition_allowed.
global_rules.duplicate_fact_rule: The same economic fact on the face and in a note is one fact with multiple evidence references, not two additive values. This also applies to two face captions that report the same amount (see equivalence blocks).
parent_child_allocation: Never load a gross parent and its separately mapped children additively.
Residual = reported parent minus confirmed included children.
Subtract only on explicit inclusion wording, hierarchy, reconciliation or arithmetic support.
If containment is uncertain, retain the parent as evidence and route to review.
global_rules.no_fabricated_split: Never invent a decomposition. Where only a combined figure is reported, load the combined concept and leave the children empty. The one exception is a concept declaring sole_component_of: assigning a whole undifferentiated figure to a single child divides nothing, and it is refused as soon as any sibling child is evidenced on the face or in the subtotal's own note.
global_rules.totals_policy: Compute totals from mutually exclusive concept outputs. Use reported totals only for validation, never as an input to the components.

mutually_exclusive_groups.rule: Populate the aggregate only when the face prints a single undifferentiated 'Reserves' line and no component of it is printed. If any component is printed — on the face or as a closing balance of the statement of changes in equity — populate the components and leave the aggregate null.
mutually_exclusive_groups.note: China SCE 1966 and 嘉民 print 'Reserves 儲備' on the face and break it down in the statement of changes in equity, whose closing balances sum to it exactly (9,358,611 and 2,361,865). Filing both counted every reserve twice: published Equity & Reserves was 42,335,984 and 4,529,714 against 12,605,743 and 2,191,372 by the template's own definition.

scope_selection.note: Absent from v1 and a common cause of silent mis-loads on HKEX filings.

entity_scope.rule: Where a statement prints Group and Company columns side by side, take the Group (consolidated) column. Record entity_scope on every fact. Never mix columns within one statement.
company_only_markers: Presence of bs_non_current_assets__investments_in_subsidiaries on the face is strong evidence the column is company-only, since consolidation eliminates it.

period_selection.rule: Identify the current period from the column heading date, not from column position; HKEX filings are not consistently current-first. Load comparatives only into the comparative period slot.
period_selection.restatement_rule: Where a comparative column is labelled restated / 重列 / 經重列, load it as the comparative and set restated: true. Do not overwrite a previously loaded original comparative; keep both with a restatement flag.

units_and_currency.rule: Resolve currency and scale from the statement header, not the cover page, and re-resolve per statement. Persist unit on every fact; never normalise scale silently.
units_and_currency.conflict: If header scale and a printed subtotal are inconsistent by a factor of 1,000, trust neither: route the statement to review.

scope_selection.column_guard: Every fact carries the resolved (entity_scope, period, currency, unit). Two facts for the same canonical_key that differ on any of these are distinct facts, not duplicates.

residual_framework.note: One definition governing the 11 output-template subsection residuals. Each uses an existing template line; no template row is added.

sweep.runs: after all dedicated concepts in the section have been resolved, before section reconciliation
sweep.candidate_set: every printed value row on the FACE of the statement whose resolved section equals the residual's single section_scope value
eligibility: The row printed a value for the selected entity_scope, period, currency and unit.
No dedicated concept whose section_scope contains this section claimed the row.

The row is not a section subtotal, statement total, section header, attribution caption, per-share figure, narrative row, note-reference-only row, truncated caption, an of which breakdown of the row above it (其中：/ of which) or a sub-enumerated component of it (（一）… / 1.… beneath 五、净利润) — each of those amounts is already inside the row above, so sweeping it counts the same money twice.
The row was printed INSIDE this section. A row printed in any other section is ineligible however similar its wording — there is no cross-section rescue.

The row's sign agrees with the section's sign_convention, where the section states one. A row signed against its section is evidence the SECTION is wrong, not the amount, so it goes to review rather than into the bucket — a cost swept into income moves the income subtotal and every total below it.
sweep.plug_behaviour: forbidden — the residual is never computed as (reported subtotal − mapped children)
sweep.literal_others_caption: A row captioned 'Others' / '其他' is simply one unmapped face row and sweeps in as a single component. It gets no privileged treatment and no dedicated concept.

itemisation.rule: The residual's value is the arithmetic sum of its components. Original labels and signs are always retained; a swept row is never relabelled to 'Others'.

reconciliation.identity: reported_section_subtotal − Σ(dedicated concepts in section) − Σ(residual components) = 0
reconciliation.tolerance: one rounding unit per contributing row
reconciliation.on_failure: Emit an unallocated_gap fact carrying the difference and route the section to review. Never adjust the residual, and never adjust a dedicated concept, to close the gap.
reconciliation.sections_without_reported_subtotal: If the section prints no subtotal, the residual is still itemised but is flagged unreconciled and carries lower confidence.

review_triggers: any single component exceeds 2% of |reported section subtotal|
a component label scored at or above the semantic threshold against a dedicated concept but was vetoed by exclude_hints
residual sign is opposite to the section's sign_convention
the section reconciliation emitted an unallocated_gap
prohibitions: Never populated by alias, regex or embedding match.
Never carries a value with no itemised components.
Never absorbs a row a dedicated concept could have claimed but was not tested for — all dedicated concepts in the section must be evaluated first.
Never spans sections, statements, periods, entity scopes or units.

cascade.note: MAX_VALID(Find 1, Find 2, Find 3) — the spec's own selection rule, now expressible. The three Finds are three readings of ONE quantity and the fullest disclosure wins, which is why this is a maximum and not a sum: summing them would count the same related-party receivable up to three times. Every term is `any_of`, so a filing that discloses only one of the three still answers with that one, and a filing that discloses none leaves the line empty rather than publishing zero (spec 3.6). `outranks_printed` because no balance sheet prints this quantity: it is related-party amounts extracted from within four receivable captions, net of entrusted loans, and a caption binding this line found something else. This replaces six first-available rungs whose own note recorded that they could not express the rule.

items.label: Secur & Other Fincl Assets(LTP)
items.definition: Securities and other financial assets held as NON-CURRENT assets — the same classes of investment as the current portion (fair value through profit or loss or other comprehensive income, equity and debt securities, bonds, funds, wealth management products) but not expected to be realised within one year, including the non-current portion of a holding a note splits between current and non-current. The non-current securities and other financial assets (Find 1 LTP) less the Level 3 amount the current line could not absorb.

cascade.note: Find 1 LTP less the current line's overshoot. Find 1 LTP is the eight non-current parts, each already the sum of a note's NON-CURRENT line items with derivatives, other receivables and associate/JV/related-party investments left out — so there is no Find 2 and no split row to take afterwards. Each part is `any_of`, so a filing printing only some of these notes sums the ones it prints. The overshoot (`sub__fa_cp_intermediate_residual`, Find 3 − Find 1 of the current line) is the Level 3 amount the current line could not absorb, and is `required`: without an overshoot this rung does not resolve and LTP_P2 answers. Passed over below zero.
Find 1 LTP with no carry-forward: the current line did not overshoot, or deducting the overshoot went below zero. Passed over below zero — a negative carrying amount is not a figure a filing asserts.

FALLBACK TO THE FACE, for a filing whose notes give none of Find 1 LTP: the printed non-current FVTPL / FVTOCI / 其他非流动金融资产 / 其他权益工具投资 / 债权投资 row through its face part. LAST, so it never displaces a note reading.

items.definition: Securities and other financial assets held as CURRENT assets — financial assets at fair value through profit or loss and through other comprehensive income, listed and unlisted equity and debt securities, corporate and government bonds, investment and money market funds, wealth management products, structured deposits and certificates of deposit, expected to be realised within one year. cascade.note: Find 1 − Find 3. Find 1 is the six current parts, each already the sum of a note's CURRENT line items with derivatives and other receivables left out — so there is no Find 2 and no non-current deduction to take afterwards. Each part is `any_of`, so a filing printing only some of these notes sums the ones it prints. Find 3 (Level 3) is an `adjustment`, so a filing with no fair value hierarchy table subtracts nothing. PASSED OVER WHEN IT COMPUTES BELOW ZERO, and the next rung then publishes zero.

Zero WHEN FIND 1 − FIND 3 WENT BELOW ZERO, and only then. `sub__fa_cp_intermediate_residual` resolves only in that case (it is Find 3 − Find 1, passed over when negative), so min(0, residual) is 0 exactly where the rule says "treat Find 1 as Find 3 and make this field zero"; the overshoot itself is carried to Securities (LTP). AHEAD OF THE FACE, so an overshoot publishes zero rather than falling through to the printed row.

FALLBACK TO THE FACE, for a filing whose notes give none of Find 1: the printed current trading / FVTPL row through its face part. `derived` keys are unmatchable by caption, so without this part the printed row reached no column and the residual sweep filed it on the section's catch-all. LAST, so it never displaces a note reading, and after CP_ZERO, so a Level 3 overshoot publishes zero rather than the face.

items.label: Periods
items.definition: Number of months covered by the current reporting period. Derive from explicit current-period start and end dates or explicit duration when available.

items.label: Total Assets
items.definition: Control total equal to total assets for the current reporting date. Populate from the referenced canonical key in the existing statement ontology.

items.label: Total Equity & Reserves & Liab
items.definition: Control total equal to total equity and liabilities for the current reporting date. Populate from the referenced canonical key in the existing statement ontology.

items.label: Total Income & Expenses
items.definition: Control result from the income statement for the current reporting period. Populate from the referenced canonical key in the existing statement ontology.

items.label: Unexplained Adj to Ret Profits
items.definition: Residual control needed to reconcile opening retained profits, current-period movements and closing retained profits. Populate from the referenced canonical key in the existing statement ontology.

items.label: Difference
items.definition: Balance-sheet reconciliation difference between total assets and total equity and liabilities. Calculate after both control totals have been populated.

items.label: Audit Opinion(Stmt Source)
items.definition: Type of external auditor opinion expressed on the financial statements. Classify from the formal audit opinion paragraph.

items.label: Accounting Standard
items.definition: Financial reporting framework explicitly used to prepare the statements. Use the explicit framework in the basis-of-preparation or auditor report.

items.label: Accountant
items.definition: Name of the external auditor or reporting accountant associated with the financial statements. Use the audit firm signing the report; capture engagement partner separately only if another ontology requires it.

items.label: Analyst
items.definition: Analyst assigned to prepare or review the financial spread. Populate from workflow metadata or user input.

items.label: Statement type
items.definition: Frequency or reporting nature of the source statements. Use explicit document title and reporting period.

items.label: Status
items.definition: Workflow status of the extraction or financial spread. Populate from workflow state.

items.label: Reconcile To
items.definition: Comparative reporting date against which the current-period statement is reconciled. Use the comparative column date corresponding to the current statement.

items.label: Exchange Rate(Period End)
items.definition: Exchange rate applicable at the reporting date for converting source currency into target currency. Extract only an explicitly reported amount matching the defined scope. Retain the reported date, currency, unit and consolidation scope.

items.label: Num Outstanding Common Shares
items.definition: Number of ordinary or common shares outstanding at the reporting date. Extract only an explicitly reported amount matching the defined scope. Retain the reported date, currency, unit and consolidation scope.

items.label: Num Outstanding Preferred Shares
items.definition: Number of preference or preferred shares outstanding at the reporting date. Extract only an explicitly reported amount matching the defined scope. Retain the reported date, currency, unit and consolidation scope.

items.label: Num Employees
items.definition: Reported number of employees or workforce headcount at or near the reporting date. Extract only an explicitly reported amount matching the defined scope. Retain the reported date, currency, unit and consolidation scope.

items.label: Net Technical Reserve(Equity side)*Insur. Co. Only

items.label: Off Balance Sheet Assets

items.label: Operating Lease Commitments

items.label: Pledged Assets

items.label: Secure Borrowings

items.label: Derivatives

Capture the complete relevant disclosure with note number, reporting period, currency, unit, scope and exact source location. Preserve separate amounts and categories as structured child facts where available.

items.label: Contingent liabilities
items.definition: Contingent liabilities disclosed in the notes: the guarantees, letters of credit, performance bonds and bank guarantees the entity has given and that are still in force at the reporting date, summed. Litigation, claims and other matters that are not guarantees are described in the disclosure but are not part of this figure.
items.note_use_rationale: A contingent liability is disclosed only in the notes, so there is no face amount for a note to corroborate; evidence_only would make this concept unfillable by any route.

cascade.note: The contingent liabilities note (或有负债 / 或有事项 / 或然負債 / Contingent liabilities): every guarantee-type exposure it lists, summed as line items. FIRST, because it is the note the disclosure is about.

A dedicated financial-guarantees note (財務擔保 / 对外担保 / Financial guarantees), for a filing that states its guarantees there instead. A RUNG, not a term of CL_P1: the same guarantee is often restated in both notes, and adding them would count it twice.
Guarantees given for related parties (关联担保 / 關聯擔保), for a filing that discloses them only in the related-party note. Last, for the same reason as CL_P2.

items.label: Auditor's opinion

Preserve separate amounts and categories as structured child facts where available.

WHY ONLY THE NON-CURRENT ONES. This Find feeds `bs_nca__due_from_related_parties_ltp`, which the template rolls up into total non-current assets, while every CURRENT related-party receivable column (`bs_ca__due_from_related_parties_cp`, the JV and partnership line, the related-party trade receivable and the trade-and-other aggregate) is a child of total CURRENT assets and publishes in its own right. Adding those here puts one balance in both sections. Measured on China SCE, whose face prints a single "Due from related parties" 4,065,231 under CURRENT ASSETS: with them, the non-current children summed to 52,567,208 against a printed 49,227,234 — an overshoot of 3,339,974; without them the residual is -725,257, which is the ordinary under-extraction.

THE SIX ENTRUSTED-LOAN COLUMNS ARE ABSENT on purpose: 但不包括委托贷款, the spec's own exclusion, expressed by not naming them so there is no pattern to get wrong. The parent is not a term either — it selects between the three Finds, so naming it here would be a cycle.

BOTH MATURITIES IS THE DECLARED INTENT, and this Find is the one place that does not follow it. Instructed: "Template intent is both long and short term on related party." Find 3 already reads both — its row captions take 其他应收款 and 一年内到期的长期应收款 alongside 长期应收款 — and on 000709 it is the rung that wins, so the column publishes 379,049,251.75 / 347,653,398.14: the whole related-party receivable note net of its allowance, current balances included. The intent is therefore already met wherever the note is read.

WHAT KEEPS THE FACE RUNG NON-CURRENT ANYWAY is a measurement, not a disagreement with the instruction. Widening this rung to the four current columns (bs_ca__due_from_related_parties_cp, the JV and partnership line, the related-party trade receivable and the trade-and-other aggregate) was tried and measured on the corpus: on China SCE 1966 it published the face's 4,065,231 / 3,914,425 into the LTP column while bs_ca__due_from_related_parties_cp still published the same balance, and the bs_nca__total_non_current_assets reconciliation went from tying EXACTLY (49,227,234 reported against 49,227,234 accounted, and 60,780,612 against 60,780,612) to `mixed_scale` — the one section relation that filing proves, lost. The face prints CP and LTP as two rows and the template rolls them into two different section totals, so a face reading cannot take both without counting one balance twice; a NOTE reading can, because the note is a decomposition and not a section. That is the split the three Finds now record.

cascade.note: FIND 3 IS THE NET, and the note it reads publishes only the two halves. The spec asks for the 淨金額 (net amount); a 关联方应收应付款项 table prints 账面余额 and 坏账准备 and no net column, so the net is gross LESS allowance and has to be computed here. items.label: Non-operating income (face row)

It is one of the two halves of the template's single net column Other Non-Operating Inc(Exp), which is its parent and which sums the two, so this part must carry the figure NEGATIVE — see its sign_rule, which negates the CAS caption only, and its negative_expected sign_convention, which flags any remaining positive for review rather than coercing it.

items.label: Income taxes paid (direct-method face row)
items.definition: The cash-flow row a mainland filing prints as 支付的各项税费 — the income taxes and other levies actually PAID in cash during the period, read off the face of the direct-method operating section (CAS 31 presents the direct method on the face and the indirect reconciliation as a note). CAS prints it as an UNSIGNED POSITIVE magnitude that the statement's own 经营活动现金流出小计 subtotal deducts, so this part must carry the figure NEGATIVE — see its sign_rule, which negates the CAS captions only and leaves an HKFRS filing's already-bracketed figure alone. It is one of the two halves of the template's single net column Income Taxes Paid(Direct), which is its parent and which sums the two; the other half is the refund received. It is NOT the income tax EXPENSE of the income statement, which accrues rather than pays and has its own template line.

items.label: Tax refunds received (direct-method face row)
items.definition: The cash-flow row a mainland filing prints as 收到的税费返还 — refunds of tax RECEIVED in cash, most often the VAT export rebate and overpaid income tax, read off the face of the direct-method operating section above 经营活动现金流入小计. It is a cash INFLOW and stays positive. It is the second half of the template's single net column Income Taxes Paid(Direct), which is its parent and which sums the two, so the parent reports taxes paid NET of refunds — which is what a template carrying one tax line per statement can mean. Before this part existed the caption reached no concept and was swept into the operating section's residual bucket alongside the indirect reconciliation's non-cash adjustments, where it was added to two other direct-method rows under one figure.
